rationales.rules-based-checks-v3: SAST/SCA and license scanners run on AI-generated code diffs as part of the deployed governance guardrails ('AI-generated diffs are subject to SAST/SCA, license checks... high-risk findings block merge'; 'AI-generated code passed SAST/SCA/license scans'). These are deterministic, non-AI tools checking code against general security/vulnerability/CVE and license-policy rules, with a coded hard-block threshold gating merge. They are used *within* RetailCo's system (not merely as the study's measuring instrument), so the use condition (§104/§115) is met. The separate LLM 'AI reviewer' is AI review and does not drive this fire; the scanners do.
